label: GOOD_4 for all in act strengthens GOOD_4 for every distinct intellectual effect
note: Same IsGod, InAct, GoodIn, WillsGoodFor and esse. The strong version gives a willed good to every existing being, God included; the weak one only to a distinct intellectual being whose being God causes. Control part 5: with no intellectual being other than God and no willing, the weak version holds and the strong one fails.
